subject: BrightStack / Redwood: Summit Spotlight cohort session — logistics & assets
messages:
From: Nina Kapoor <nina@brightstack.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: EdgeScale Summit — Summit Spotlight cohort slot (Feb 23)

Hi Alex —

Hope you're well. Quick ask: we're running a curated 'Summit Spotlight' track at EdgeScale Summit (Feb 22–24) and would love Redwood to co-host a 30-minute cohort session + short live demo on Feb 23. The format is a 20min discussion / 10min live demo, 200-person targeted audience (platform and infra engineers).

High-level asks:
- Two speakers from Redwood + one moderator from BrightStack
- A co-branded slide deck and a 1-paragraph promo blurb by Jan 25
- Logo/brand assets for the event site by Jan 25
- We can offer a complimentary expo table and a promo code for attendees (REDWOOD20 => 20% off)

Can Redwood confirm interest and who would present? Also any demo AV constraints we should know about.

Attaching the session-level agenda we circulated to partners.

Best,
Nina Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, BrightStack
attachments: brightstack_edge_agenda.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nina Kapoor <nina@brightstack.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EdgeScale Summit — Summit Spotlight cohort slot (Feb 23)

Thanks Nina — excited about this. Redwood is interested and 30 minutes works. A couple quick clarifying Qs so we can lock speakers and assets:

- Target audience level: is this operator-level (hands-on infra) or higher-level platform strategy?
- Do you need a slide deck in a specific aspect ratio (16:9 usual) or any template?
- AV — will you provide a conference laptop + HDMI, or should we bring our own machine for the live demo?
- Promo code logistics: is REDWOOD20 already provisioned? Any referral tracking link?

Looping in Camila (marketing) and Sergio (Field) to coordinate content and speaker selection. We should confirm speakers by EOD Jan 18 to meet Jan 25 asset deadline.

—Alex Martinez
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Cc: BrightStack Events <events@brightstack.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:45:00 -0800

Thanks Alex — good questions. Answers below: 

- Audience: primarily platform engineers and infra leads (hands-on, looking for operational takeaways). Expect 150–250 depending on track.
- Deck: 16:9 is perfect; we host a partner template but co-branding is fine.
- AV: we provide a conference laptop and HDMI + lav mics. If you have a GPU-heavy demo that needs a local machine, bring it — we can reserve a table for it near the stage.
- Promo code: REDWOOD20 is active. We'll send a tracking link (events platform) tomorrow; promo code also shows in our reports.

Deadlines: Jan 25 for deck + logos + speaker bios so we can finalize the site and social schedule.

Attaching the partner agenda doc.

Best,
Nina Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, BrightStack
